While full-year guidance is not formally raised, the forward language is confident and the trajectory is clearly improving, warranting a score above 0.0 but below the threshold for a formal guidance raise.

evidence.claim: RoTE has increased consistently every quarter since Q1 2024, reaching 11.1% over the last 12 months.
evidence.quote: our RoTE over the last 12 months reached 11.1% and that excludes the impacts of inorganic activity last year . And this [trailing 12 month] measure has increased consistently every quarter since Q1 2024¹, starting at 10% then 10.1%, 10.4%, 10.5%, 11%, and now 11.1%.

evidence.claim: Management states they are 'firmly on track' to achieve objectives for 2025, 2026, and beyond.
evidence.quote: we are delivering consistently , and by doing so, we remain firmly on track to achieve our objectives for 2025, 2026, and with further ambition beyond that.

evidence.claim: Structural hedge yield is currently 2.5% and expected to increase, supporting multi-year NII growth beyond 2026.
evidence.quote: The overall yield on the hedge is currently 2.5 % and as you know, this will increase over time as we reinvest a significant proportion of the portfolio each year . T o help you think about the trajectory, in 2027 the maturing yield on our book will be c.2.1%, supporting strongly positive income growth from reinvestment and multi -year NII growth beyond 2026 .

evidence.claim: UK mortgage growth: Q2 marked the fourth quarter of net mortgage growth.
evidence.quote: Q2 marked the fourth quarter of net mortgage growth, the third quarter of corporate lending growth, and the second quarter of core Business Banking loan growth.

evidence.claim: US cards NIM is expected to progress further from repricing actions, deposit growth, and GM onboarding.
evidence.quote: We did see progression in the NIM and I expect to see further progression from here. And that's really coming from the repricing actions which continue to mature... we continue to grow a deposit... the other thing that's going to help us progress Jordan, is, bringing on GM.

evidence.claim: Investment Bank stable income sources rose to 40% of IB income from 29% in 2021.
evidence.quote: within the Investment Bank as a whole these stable sources of income accounted for 40% of our income in the past year , up from 29% in 2021.

evidence.claim: Cost savings program: £1.35 billion of the £2 billion target achieved at half-year of the plan.
evidence.quote: we got £2 billion target for the three years together . Actually , at the end of the first half of the plan we're at £1.35 billion.

evidence.claim: Risk: Delay in US card model implementation affecting RWA allocation.
evidence.quote: the timing of the implementation of the US card model could be 2026/2027 and somewhat out of our hands, Chris .

evidence.claim: Risk: Uncertainty around Pillar 2A in UK Basel.
evidence.quote: at this point in time we have no clarity as to what will happen for Pillar 2A in UK Basel. So Pillar 1 is going to go up, we might expect a degree of offset and Pillar 2A, but we don’t know what that is yet.

evidence.claim: Risk: Inflation hitting cost base on a lagged basis.
evidence.quote: Inflation tends to hit us on a lagged basis so if we did see a pickup in inflation, we would expect to see that pressure a little bit further out because it tends to feed through into property and into people costs on a bit of a lag. And that's one of the reasons why we're still seeing quite high inflation coming through the cost base in 2025 when actually the headline rate dropped in 2024.

evidence.claim: Risk: Execution risk on cost savings beyond 2026, as technology-focused savings are harder.
evidence.quote: I think the sort of bigger point that we are thoughtful about now is really what’s beyond 2026 and really how do we keep that focus on efficiency. And as I said in my remarks, it's really technology focused, and process focused. That's clearly harder to do than people and property .
we are delivering consistently , and by doing so, we remain firmly on track to achieve our objectives for 2025, 2026, and with further ambition beyond that.
